title: Lorraine I NDE 900
content:
When I left my body, I was several inches above it, and it took me a few moments to understand. I began to slowly rise and then entered the path of light that was coming through the window, which seemed to show an outline of my 'body' and I was worried they may see it. I realized I was dead as I looked down on my body on the bed. I realized that all the experiences of 'Lorraine' were left behind, in her mind, and that I was something separate. I thought about my funeral and how people would react, that my parents would be upset, but that was okay as 'pain' was something that was natural and that they would simply have to live through and accept. These people were my 'earthly' parents. The connection had been left behind. I rose through the house and above the roofs and I could see into the people's back gardens. (Some time after I returned I had planned to put a note through people's doors to tell them what I had seen of their homes.) I rose higher, had an 'rial view of the surroundings, and imagined a police car turning up to the house to discover my body. I then entered some other dimension and was greeted by people who I feel were my relatives or at least were absolutely overjoyed to see me and greeted me with overwhelming love. I have a split second recollection of being then surrounded by the most beautiful living light, which breathed and surrounded me with unimaginable love. I was told I had to return and this caused me terrible emotional pain to have to go back to my life and that room again. In order to give me strength, I was shown my future, from the point of return, all through my entire life. It was flashed across the sky and I was living and experiencing every moment of it, right up until my death. There were years and years of terrible pain, I couldn't believe it went on for so long, but slowly it began to lessen and then to level out and then slowly, good feelings and events began to happen and they got better and better until my future was full of wonderful happy experiences, feelings and events. I then found myself back in my body. I could hear one of the men sounding worried and saying that I could get off the bed. He said it several times until I finally registered that I was back. I felt that I was in hell; I had experienced hell then heaven and then returned to hell again, all in the space of an hour or so. They showed me the door after telling me not to tell anyone but I couldn't believe they even had to ask me. I felt so contaminated and poisoned that I felt I was one of them. I didn't want to live or leave the house, but they showed me the door. I went home and didn't tell anyone, and in a very short space of time, I lost faith in what I was shown and instead believed that 'God' was cruelly torturing me and that I had done something terrible. We used to say prayers every day in school and I can remember looking at all the other children in the class, remembering how I had been one of them, not really believing that there was really anything beyond, but knowing now that there was, and that they were all in ignorance of this knowledge. I remember looking in the mirror at my face and my body and realizing it was just a shell, and that I was spirit. Within a space of approximately three months, I had managed to remove all memory of the attack and the NDE from my conscious knowledge.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Entered a "path of light" coming through the window.

arrival.other_being_detail: Greeted by people she felt were her relatives (or similar), "absolutely overjoyed" and expressing overwhelming love.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being in "some other dimension" and then surrounded by "the most beautiful living light" that "breathed."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: An "attack" is mentioned but not described medically.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Future was shown "flashed across the sky" and she lived/experienced every moment through to death.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (above body, rising through house) → entered path of light → entered other dimension and greeted by relatives → surrounded by living light → told to return → shown future → returned to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A detailed personal future preview was shown "flashed across the sky" and experienced moment-by-moment through to her death; she also reported planning to leaflet neighbors about what she saw in their gardens; she reported suppressing memory of the attack and NDE within ~3 months.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "surrounded by the most beautiful living light, which breathed and surrounded me with unimaginable love"; "I felt that I was in hell; I had experienced hell then heaven and then returned to hell again"; "I remember looking in the mirror at my face and my body and realizing it was just a shell, and that I was spirit."
